name: pw-recorder
description: 可录制的 Playwright IDE：悬浮面板 + 终端命令控制，用户操作实时转 Playwright Test 代码并导出 .spec.js

scripts.replay-check: npm run demo:record && npm run demo:replay
scripts.live:verify: node scripts/record-live.js --url https://demo.playwright.dev/todomvc/ --driver scripts/live/todomvc.js --title "todomvc flow" --verify && playwright test tests/recorded/todomvc.verify.spec.js
